Exploitability_explanation: Vulnerable API `serialize()` is not explicitly called in the user code. It is a transitive dependency used internally by plugins (e.g. uglifyjs-webpack-plugin). Since it is internal usage only with no reachable user-controlled path, exploitability is capped at 0.01 (1%).
